vocabulary.meaning_en: an idea or plan that you offer for someone to think about
advice about what is best to do
vocabulary.example: My recommendation is to start early.

vocabulary.meaning_en: not saying something in a straight, strong way

vocabulary.word: on the spur of the moment
vocabulary.example: We went to the beach on the spur of the moment.
Let's do something spontaneous this weekend.

vocabulary.meaning_en: include me; I want to join
vocabulary.example: A trip to the mountains? Count me in!

vocabulary.meaning_en: not wanting to do something, but doing it anyway

vocabulary.example: I'm not sure that would be appropriate.

vocabulary.meaning_en: think carefully about something for a time

vocabulary.example: It's a big decision. Let me sleep on it.

vocabulary.meaning_en: something I like (usually negative: not my cup of tea)
vocabulary.example: Camping is not my cup of tea.
I'm not keen on that idea.

fine_lines.title: Verb patterns after suggestion phrases
fine_lines.explanation_ar: should + الفعل الأساسي (بدون to). How about / What about / Do you fancy / Would you be interested in + ing. I thought you might like + to + الفعل. Let's وShall we + الفعل الأساسي.
fine_lines.explanation_en: should + base verb (no "to"). How about / What about / Do you fancy / Would you be interested in + -ing. I thought you might like + to + verb. Let's and Shall we + base verb.

examples.sentence: I think you should go to the doctor.
Would you be interested in going to the museum?
I thought you might like to stay at home tonight.

fine_lines.title: might as well vs may as well
fine_lines.explanation_ar: المعنى واحد: بما أنه لا يوجد خيار أفضل، فلنفعل هذا.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Same meaning: there is no better option, so let's do this.

examples.sentence: They're not coming. We might as well start dinner.
It's raining. We may as well stay in.

expressions.example: You're not well. I think you should go to the doctor.

expressions.meaning_en: A polite suggestion when you're not sure they'll agree.
expressions.example: Would you be interested in going to the cinema on Saturday?

expressions.phrase: I thought perhaps you might like to ...
expressions.example: I thought perhaps you might like to invite your mother for lunch.

expressions.phrase: I was thinking it would be a nice change if we ...
expressions.meaning_ar: كنت أفكر أنه سيكون تغييرًا لطيفًا لو ...
expressions.example: I was thinking it would be a nice change if we went abroad this year.
How about painting the room yellow?

expressions.meaning_en: A short, direct suggestion that includes you.
expressions.example: Let's go away for the weekend.
Let's not argue about it.
Do you fancy calling in for a pizza on the way home?

expressions.meaning_en: A polite suggestion with "we" (or an offer with "I").
expressions.example: Shall we book that restaurant for next week?

expressions.meaning_ar: لا بأس أن ... (لعدم وجود خيار أفضل)
expressions.meaning_en: Suggests something because there is no better option.
expressions.example: It's nine o'clock and they're not here. We might as well start dinner.

expressions.phrase: That sounds like a great idea.
expressions.example: A picnic on Friday? That sounds like a great idea.

expressions.meaning_en: A positive reply; the idea could work.
expressions.example: Ask the team? That's not a bad idea.

expressions.meaning_ar: أظن أنك وصلت إلى شيء مهم.
expressions.meaning_en: Says someone has found a good idea.
expressions.example: Hmm, I think you're onto something there.

expressions.phrase: Brilliant! Why didn't I think of that?
expressions.meaning_ar: رائع! لماذا لم أفكر في ذلك؟
expressions.example: A weekend by the sea? Brilliant! Why didn't I think of that?
You're going to watch the match? Count me in too!
You're probably right. I'll apologise to her.
Paint it on Saturday morning? Sounds perfect.
You'll cook lunch on Sunday? That would be lovely.

expressions.meaning_ar: ربما بشكل شبه مؤكد (لست متأكدًا بعد).
expressions.meaning_en: A funny way to say "probably, but I'm not sure yet".
expressions.example: Are you coming on Saturday? — It's a definite maybe.
Will it work? — I don't think so.

expressions.phrase: I'm not sure that would be appropriate.
expressions.meaning_ar: لست متأكدًا أن ذلك سيكون مناسبًا.
expressions.meaning_en: A polite refusal; the idea doesn't suit the situation.
expressions.example: A big party now? I'm not sure that would be appropriate.
Hmm, I'm not sure about that. Let me sleep on it.

expressions.meaning_en: Shows you are uncomfortable with the idea.
expressions.example: Well, I don't know. What if it goes wrong?

expressions.phrase: To be honest, it's not my cup of tea.
expressions.meaning_en: Says politely that you don't like it.
expressions.example: Squash? To be honest, it's not my cup of tea.
Do you think it will work? — No, not really.

expressions.phrase: I'm not keen on that idea.
expressions.meaning_en: Says you don't like the idea.
expressions.example: Camping? I'm not keen on that idea.
Go out tonight? No, I'd rather not. I'm tired.

expressions.phrase: I'm sorry, I really don't feel like it.
expressions.meaning_ar: آسف، لا رغبة لي في ذلك حقًا.
expressions.meaning_en: Says you don't want to do it now.
expressions.example: I'm sorry, I really don't feel like it. Perhaps another time.

grammar.title: should + base verb (no "to")
grammar.explanation_ar: بعد الفعل الناقص should يأتي الفعل الأساسي بدون to وبدون ing: you should go وليس you should to go.
grammar.explanation_en: After the modal "should" use the base verb, with no "to" and no -ing: "you should go", not "you should to go".

grammar.title: Shall I / Shall we
grammar.explanation_ar: نستخدم shall في الأسئلة مع I وwe فقط للاقتراح أو العرض. لا نقول Shall you.
grammar.explanation_en: Use "shall" in questions only with "I" and "we" for suggestions and offers. We don't say "Shall you".
examples: Shall we take a few days off?

grammar.title: It would be a nice change if + past simple
grammar.explanation_ar: بعد would ... if نستخدم الماضي البسيط لنتحدث عن فكرة متخيَّلة في المستقبل.
grammar.explanation_en: After "It would be ... if" use the past simple to talk about an imagined idea.
examples: It would be a nice change if we went abroad.
It would be nice if we stayed home this year.
It would be great if we bought a new sofa.

questions.question: I think you should ___ to the doctor.
Would you be interested in ___ to the museum?
Which question is NOT correct?
questions.explanation_ar: لا نستخدم shall مع you في الاقتراحات.
questions.explanation_en: We don't use "shall" with "you" for suggestions.

questions.question: "Count me in!" means:
questions.explanation_en: "Count me in" = I want to join.

questions.question: Which is a polite NEGATIVE response?
choices: To be honest, it's not my cup of tea.
questions.explanation_ar: not my cup of tea طريقة مهذبة لقول لا يعجبني.
questions.explanation_en: "Not my cup of tea" politely says you don't like it.

questions.question: They aren't coming. We ___ as well start dinner.
questions.explanation_ar: might as well = بما أنه لا خيار أفضل.
questions.explanation_en: "Might as well" = there's no better option.

questions.question: "Let me sleep on it" means:
questions.explanation_ar: sleep on it = يؤجّل القرار ليفكر.

questions.question: It would be a nice change if we ___ abroad this year.
questions.explanation_ar: بعد would ... if نستخدم الماضي البسيط.
questions.explanation_en: Use the past simple after "would ... if".

questions.question: Do you fancy ___ a pizza?
questions.explanation_ar: بعد Do you fancy نستخدم ing أو اسمًا.
questions.explanation_en: After "Do you fancy" use -ing or a noun.
